messages:
tina (cs): Customer on enterprise plan reports invoice for Mar shows 1,203,412 tokens billed but dashboard 'served_tokens' for their org is ~702k. They say traffic pattern is chat streaming with a lot of short prefix prompts + user context. Can eng help triage?

sara (support): thanks — can you drop customer org id + invoice id? Also any example request IDs or approximate time window?

tina (cs): org=acme-inc, invoice=INV-2026-03-17, window=2026-03-01..2026-03-15. Customer provided two sample request_ids: r-8a3f and r-8a7b (timestamps in logs). They mentioned using our streaming JS SDK with continuousBatcher enabled.

ajay (eng): pinging eng. initial thought: continuous batching + prefix/KV prefetch can cause billed tokens to include warmup/prefetch tokens that never end up in final served output. Need traces. Can you grab the meter logs for those request ids? look for meter.event=token_count and runtime.event=served_token_count.

matt (sre): quick note: our metrics pipeline emits two separate counters: meter.tokens.billed (what billing uses) and runtime.tokens.served (what console counts). They are derived from different hooks — billing attaches at pre-exec batching boundary, runtime attaches when response stream emits. Under certain prefetch/batcher scenarios billed can exceed served.

sara (support): filing to internal case ENG-7892 and CC'ing customer. Tina — asked customer to allow log share.

billing-bot: automated snapshot attached: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2026-03-17/snapshot (shows line items + meter.tokens.billed totals).

ajay (eng): reproduction plan I'm going to run locally: 1) enable continuousBatcher with max_wait_ms=50 and prefetch enabled 2) send 200 concurrent short prefix prompts where many share the same KV prefix 3) capture pipeline logs and meter events. sample client call:```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({
  model: 'rwd-4k-quant',
  messages: [{role:'user', content: 'summarize: ' + prefix}],
  continuousBatch: true,
  batch_hint: {max_wait_ms:50}
});
```

ajay (eng): example log snippet we see in repro:```
[2026-03-05T12:01:02Z] batcher.request id=b-112 warmup_prefetch=true prefetch_tokens=1200
[2026-03-05T12:01:02Z] meter.emit tenant=acme_inc meter.tokens.billed=1200 source=batcher_prefetch
[2026-03-05T12:01:02Z] runtime.emit tenant=acme_inc runtime.tokens.served=340 source=stream
```

ajay (eng): the important bit: prefetch_tokens can be billed immediately at prefetch time. If the prefetch is later reused across many requests, billing attribution depends on which tenant triggered the prefetch. Also if prefetch gets evicted or not used, billed tokens remain.

matt (sre): additional nuance: continuousBatcher sometimes deduplicates prompts at runtime, so served tokens may be de-duplicated while billing kept the naive sum. Also windowing in the meter aggregator can double-count when a prefetch spans multiple small batches — aggregator checkpoints may flush the billed counter multiple times for overlapping windows.

sara (support): from customer logs they sent: billed spikes align with heavy bursts at 03:14 and 03:52 GMT where they had many small messages. They also enabled 'warm_prefixes=true' in their config.

ajay (eng): mitigation options we can apply quickly: - disable continuousBatcher for that org (config toggle) - reduce prefetch concurrency or disable warm_prefixes - set batch_max_wait_ms to 0 to force immediate dispatch (no batching) Those should lower billed tokens while we adjust meter attribution.

matt (sre): longer-term we should: 1) change billing hook to attribute prefetch tokens to the tenant that actually consumed them (de-duplicate) or 2) tag meter events with prefetch: true and have billing pipeline subtract unused prefetch tokens after a TTL, or 3) emit a "finalized_billed_tokens" event only when response completes.

ajay (eng): dev note for ENG-7892: add trace tag prefetch_id to all meter writes, add post-facto reconciliation job that subtracts prefetch tokens never consumed after 24h. Also add a console flag to show "billed (incl. prefetch)" vs "served" so customers understand delta.

billing-bot: invoice re-run performed for INV-2026-03-17 (draft) with flag show_prefetch=true. Draft difference: billed_total=1,203,412, served_total=701,989, prefetch_total=501,234.

tina (cs): customer wants immediate credit if prefetch is confirmed wasting charges. Can we offer pro-rated credit while we investigate?

sara (support): recommend we offer temporary credit for prefetch_total while ENG investigates. I'll propose 50% credit pending root-cause.

ajay (eng): agree on credit while we implement fix; also need exec approval for policy change. I'll prepare a short RCA and timeline.

matt (sre): posted a minimal checklist to reproduce in CI: 1) create tenant test-xxx 2) enable continuousBatcher + warm_prefixes 3) run 1k short requests over 5 mins with concurrency 50 4) capture meter.event and runtime.event 5) validate billed - served == prefetch_total. I'll attach the script to the ticket.

tina (cs): customer accepted temporary credit proposal. They asked for ETA for permanent fix.

ajay (eng): rough ETA: hotfix to billing attribution 2-3 days (limit prefetch immediate billing), full reconciliation + UI changes ~2 weeks. I'll update ENG-7892.

sara (support): keeping customer updated. closing this slack thread once we have confirmation logs posted in ENG-7892. thanks team :thumbsup:
